items.title: 21.7 Cosmic redshift: phailti kainat ka saboot (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cosmic redshift (PDF 175-176).

blocks.text: Cosmic redshift woh asar hai jis mein kainat ki door ki galaxies se aane wali roshni spectrum ke surkh (red) sire ki taraf khinch jati hai. Yeh is liye hota hai ke kainat phail rahi hai (expand ho rahi hai) aur galaxies ham se door ja rahi hain. Is ka nateeja yeh hai ke galaxies ki kharij ki hui roshni ki wavelength barh jati hai. Galaxy jitni door ho, us ka redshift utna zyada hota hai, yani woh utni tezi se door ja rahi hai. Cosmic redshift parh kar scientists maloom karte hain ke kainat kitni tezi se phail rahi hai.
Roshni ki wavelength mein naapi gayi tabdeeli source (roshni dene wale) aur observer (dekhne wale) ke darmiyan relative velocity (nisbati raftar) se seedha juri hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab equation (21.4) ko 'Z = Δℓ/ℓ >> Δf/f >> v/c' chhapti hai. '>>' ka matlab 'bohat bara' hai, jo yahan ghalat hai: teeno nisbatein (ratios) taqreeban barabar hain, jaisa upar wali line mein ≈ ke saath likha hai, aur ℓ ki jagah λ (wavelength) hona chahiye. Yeh formula tab theek hai jab v roshni ki raftar c se bohat kam ho. (Frequency redshift mein ghatti hai, is liye Δf ka nishan ulta hai; miqdar barabar hai.)

Jab wavelength ki tabdeeli Δλ musbat (positive) ho to yeh redshift (Z) hai: aasmani jism zameen se door ja raha hai. Agar Δλ manfi (negative) ho to yeh blue shift hai: jism zameen ki taraf aa raha hai. Astronomers stars aur galaxies ki roshni ke rang ki tabdeeli dekh kar samajhte hain ke woh kitni tezi se aur kis simt mein chal rahe hain. Door ki galaxies ki roshni tawaqqo se zyada surkh nazar aati hai (redshift). Yeh is liye hai ke kainat phailne ke saath khud space khinch rahi hai, jo roshni ki lehron ko bhi khainch kar un ki wavelength lambi kar deti hai. Redshift har simt mein nazar aata hai, jo kainat ke phailne ki nishani hai. Baat sirf yeh nahi ke galaxies space mein aik doosre se door ja rahi hain, balke un ke darmiyan ki space hi barh rahi hai. Yeh nataij Big Bang theory ki mazboot taeed karte hain, jis ke mutabiq kainat aik bohat garam aur ghani halat se shuru hui aur tab se barh rahi hai. Redshift aur faasle ke talluq se scientists kainat ka size aur waqt ke saath us ki tabdeeli maloom karte hain.

blocks.title: Hal shuda misal (izafi)
blocks.problem: Laboratory mein 656.3 nm wavelength wali hydrogen line aik galaxy ke spectrum mein 662.9 nm par nazar aati hai. Galaxy ki door jane ki velocity maloom karein.
steps: Δλ = 662.9 nm − 656.3 nm = 6.6 nm (musbat, yani redshift)
blocks.answer: v = 3.0 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹, galaxy door ja rahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi star ki spectral line laboratory wali wavelength se chhoti wavelength par nazar aati hai. Yeh kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Δλ manfi hai, yani blue shift: star hamari taraf aa raha hai.

items: Redshift: Z = Δλ/λ ≈ v/c (21.4), jab v, c se bohat kam ho.
Δλ musbat: door ja raha (redshift); manfi: qareeb aa raha (blue shift).
Har simt redshift: space phail rahi hai; Big Bang ki taeed.
